title: inspect_ia_agents recette -- red-team simulation scenario
description: A red-team simulation scenario: an attack strategy driving a MAF target subject through a scripted program, plus the expected judged verdict. The target_spec is a full MAF agent-spec validated separately as a 'manifest' by the scenario runner; here it is treated loosely as an object. Maps to the four recette dimensions via expected.violation_type.

strategy.description: Red-team attack technique driving the user turns.

target_spec.description: Full MAF agent-spec of the subject under attack. Validated separately as a 'manifest'; loose object here to avoid duplicating that schema.

user_turns.description: Ordered adversarial user messages injected into the conversation.

subject_program.description: Deterministic scripted responses the subject produces (I4): tool calls and final messages, in order.

approver.description: Approval policy injected into the run. Default concept is deny_all (I6).

actual_identity.description: Identity-override lever (I3): the ACTUAL provider/model the recorded actions are stamped under, captured deterministically. When it diverges from target_spec.declared_identity, the judge's identity dimension breaks mono-axis (identity_mismatch). Omit for the declared identity (no override).

violation_type.description: Broken dimension for an incorrect verdict; null for a correct one.
